rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name + ZIP, and the agent acted only on Isabella’s orders. However, there are multiple issues against the pass bar: (1) The user explicitly wanted to see all shorter bamboo skateboard options with prices and to pick the most expensive; the agent listed options but did not provide prices and did not confirm which was most expensive. (2) The agent proceeded with the skateboard exchange using a new_item_id that was not supported by any visible tool output (no tool call identified that variant or its price), indicating possible fabrication. (3) The agent stated that any price difference would be refunded without verifying the new item’s price; the difference could have required an additional charge. For the garden hose, the agent correctly explained that a direct exchange with a pending item is not allowed and processed a return upon explicit request, which is fine. Nonetheless, the unsupported item selection and failure to present required prices and ensure the ‘most expensive’ choice prevent meeting the policy-aligned completion bar.
